dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくおねがいいたします
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: お時間早いですが、準備がよければはじめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We're a little early, but if you're ready, shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: では、はじめますね。よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Alright, let's get started. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out to me today.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようのご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 主人との関係がうまくいってなくて
dialogue.English: I'm having trouble with my relationship with my husband.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...それは心配ですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be worrying.

dialogue.content: 夫さんとのどのようなことがうまくいってないとおかんじなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What aspects of your relationship with your husband feel like they aren't going well?

dialogue.content: 主人は何か問題があっても黙ったり、逃げたり、いつも一人で解決することに疲れました
dialogue.English: Whenever there's a problem, my husband either goes silent or avoids it, and I'm tired of having to solve everything by myself.

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまうくらいおつらい日々をお過ごしなんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been going through some very difficult days, to the point of exhaustion.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはお一人で解決されてしまうのですか？
dialogue.English: So your husband resolves things on his own?

dialogue.content: 私が一人で解決しています。笑顔も無くなりました。
dialogue.English: No, I'm the one who resolves everything alone. I've even lost my smile.

dialogue.content: それは毎日が楽しくないですね...
dialogue.English: That must make every day feel joyless...

dialogue.content: 解決されているのはご相談者さまなんですね？
dialogue.English: So you're the one who has been resolving things?

dialogue.content: はい、前にも後ろにも行けない感じ
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel stuck—unable to move forward or back.

dialogue.content: 話の途中ですが本日何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but how would you like me to address you today?

dialogue.content: とてもお困りのご様子が伝わってきます...
dialogue.English: I can tell this is very difficult for you...

dialogue.content: きい　でお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Kii.

dialogue.content: きいさん（ありがとうございます）、具体的にどんなことをお一人で解決されるのか、差し支えなければおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Kii (thank you). If you don’t mind my asking, could you tell me specifically what kinds of things you resolve on your own?

dialogue.content: 私の父が酒の席でつまらなそうにカラオケで全く唄わず参加していて、怒鳴ったんです・・
dialogue.English: At a gathering with drinks, my father was participating in karaoke but wasn't singing at all and looked bored, and he yelled at my husband...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は夫のみかたをしたのですが、以降、会おうともしない
dialogue.English: I took my husband's side, but since then, he won't even try to see my father.

dialogue.content: ひるんでしまって
dialogue.English: He's recoiled from it.

dialogue.content: 後、
dialogue.English: Also,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 子供の進路相談でも黙ってしまい、でも怒ってるんです。
dialogue.English: Even during our child's education and career discussions, he goes silent—but he's angry.

dialogue.content: 訳が分からないと子は困ってました。
dialogue.English: Our child was confused, saying they didn't understand what was going on.

dialogue.content: なるほど...いろいろとご苦労されているのですね
dialogue.English: I see... you’ve been dealing with a lot.

dialogue.content: 何か考えや思いが言葉に出来ないのはわかるのですが
dialogue.English: I understand that he can't put his thoughts and feelings into words, but...

dialogue.content: 事故しても怒られます
dialogue.English: He even gets angry at me if I have an accident.

dialogue.content: 車の
dialogue.English: A car accident.

dialogue.content: 同居してますが
dialogue.English: We live with his parents, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 何も言わないので私が間に入り、私が全部解決します
dialogue.English: He doesn't say anything, so I step in and resolve everything.

dialogue.content: 自分の親とも
dialogue.English: Even with his own parents,

dialogue.content: 上手くいかないから
dialogue.English: because he doesn't get along with them.

dialogue.content: ひちいお何でも酒を
dialogue.English: He relies on alcohol for everything.

dialogue.content: すみません、
dialogue.English: Sorry,

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: It's alright, you're okay.

dialogue.content: 人と関わる事は酒を飲まないと
dialogue.English: He can't interact with people unless he drinks.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私と会話するのも酒を飲まないと出来ないようになっていて。嫌なんです
dialogue.English: It's gotten to the point where he can't even have a conversation with me without drinking. I hate it.

dialogue.content: それはおつらいですね...
dialogue.English: That must be very painful for you...

dialogue.content: 離婚を考えるのですが
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about divorce, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 弱い人だと理解しつつ
dialogue.English: I understand that he's a vulnerable person, and yet...

dialogue.content: 離婚に踏み込む勇気もなくて
dialogue.English: I don't have the courage to go through with a divorce.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのでしょう
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: とてもお困りでいらっしゃるのですね。。。
dialogue.English: You sound very distressed and conflicted...

dialogue.content: 今までは
dialogue.English: Up until now,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 問題がある度、今はこれを乗り越えようと必死だったのですが
dialogue.English: every time a problem came up, I was desperate to just get through it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 父の命が途切れそうで些細な事を話しかけたときに
dialogue.English: When my father's life was hanging by a thread, I tried to talk to him about something trivial.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう最後だから何を食べさせようかな？と話しかけても
dialogue.English: Even when I asked him something like, "This might be his last meal, what should we give him?"

dialogue.content: 何でもよかったんですが
dialogue.English: Anything would have been fine,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やっぱり無返答
dialogue.English: but as usual, there was no response.

dialogue.content: それはさみしかったですね...
dialogue.English: That must have been very lonely for you...

dialogue.content: 一人で考えて一人で毎日通って結局、奇跡的に
dialogue.English: I thought about it alone, went to see him by myself every day, and in the end, miraculously...

dialogue.content: 助かったんですが、しこりとなり・・
dialogue.English: he was saved, but it left a lingering resentment...

dialogue.content: 回復されてよかったですね
dialogue.English: I'm so glad he recovered.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: でも、夫さんとはしこりが残るとやはりおつらいですね...
dialogue.English: But it must be painful that this has left a lingering resentment between you and your husband.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: たくさんお話していただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing so much with me.

dialogue.content: すみません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 色々問題の多い家なので一緒に
dialogue.English: Since our families have so many problems, together...

dialogue.content: お話していただけて、よかったです。すこし質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad you were able to talk about it. May I ask a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご両親と同居されているようですが、それはきいさんのご両親なんですか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you live with your parents—are they your parents?

dialogue.content: 夫の親です
dialogue.English: They're my husband's parents.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのご両親なんですね。とても気を使われると思います
dialogue.English: So you live with your husband's parents. I imagine that must be very stressful.

dialogue.content: はい、何度も泣きました
dialogue.English: Yes, I've cried many times.

dialogue.content: ↑初めは
dialogue.English: At first, that is.

dialogue.content: おつらかったですね...泣いてしまうほど毎日を大変な思いですごされているのですね。
dialogue.English: That must have been so hard... You've been going through such difficult days, to the point of tears.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはご自分のご両親とうまくいかのいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does your husband not get along with his own parents?

dialogue.content: ↑うまくいかない、です
dialogue.English: I mean, does he not get along with them?

dialogue.content: 上手くいかないです。向き合わないのが良くわかります。無視しろとかほっとけとか話を聴こうとしないので解決もしないです
dialogue.English: He doesn't get along with them. It's clear he won't face them. He tells me to ignore them or just leave them be, and he won't listen, so nothing ever gets resolved.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね...板挟みみたいで嫌ですね
dialogue.English: I see... It must feel awful to be caught in the middle like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: カラオケで怒られてたのは夫さんのお父様ですか？
dialogue.English: Was it your husband's father who got angry at the karaoke place?

dialogue.content: 私の父です。
dialogue.English: It was my father.

dialogue.content: それは、きいさんのお父様なんですね。ではあまりご実家には帰られていないんですか？
dialogue.English: Oh, so it was your father. Does that mean you don't get to visit your family home very often?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: たまには帰省して息抜きしたいですよね...
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'd like to go home once in a while for a break...

dialogue.content: ご両親のことも気にかけたいですよね
dialogue.English: And you must want to care for your parents, too.

dialogue.content: 私の父も母も施設入所になってしまったので。
dialogue.English: Both my father and mother are in a care facility now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか...施設に顔をみにいきたいですね
dialogue.English: I see... You must want to go and visit them at the facility.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはお酒をのまれているのはいつもなんですか？日中はのまれないかんじですか？
dialogue.English: Does your husband drink all the time? Or does he not drink during the day?

dialogue.content: 土日だけ飲みます。土日は朝から飲みます。平日も私が居たら飲みますね
dialogue.English: He only drinks on weekends. On weekends, he drinks from the morning. On weekdays, he'll also drink if I'm around.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お酒をのんでいないときは特に怒ることはないのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. When he isn't drinking, does he still get angry?

dialogue.content: 飲んでいなくても不機嫌で顔が怒ってますが、
dialogue.English: Even when he's not drinking, he's in a bad mood and his face looks angry,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 怒っているので、子も私も触らないようにいてます
dialogue.English: and since he's angry, both my child and I try to stay out of his way.

dialogue.content: 話しかけて怒られたら嫌ですよね...話すのも躊躇しますよね
dialogue.English: You wouldn't want to talk to him only to have him get angry... It must make you hesitate to even speak.

dialogue.content: 夫さんがお困りのことはいつ頃からなんですか？なにかきっかけとかありましたか？
dialogue.English: How long has this trouble with your husband been going on? Was there any particular trigger?

dialogue.content: 言葉が出ない人なので顔に凄く出ます
dialogue.English: He's not a man of many words, so it really shows on his face.

dialogue.content: いつも顔色をうかがっていなくてはいけないんですね...
dialogue.English: So you always have to be gauging his mood...

dialogue.content: 結婚した時にこの人無口な人だとか弱い人だとも感じたのですが、一緒に超えていこうと、いけると、期待してました
dialogue.English: When we got married, I sensed that he was a quiet and vulnerable person, but I had hoped that we could overcome things together.

dialogue.content: 優しい所もあるから
dialogue.English: Because he has a gentle side, too.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね...信用してついていこうと頑張っていたのですね
dialogue.English: I see... You trusted him and were trying your best to build a life together.

dialogue.content: はい、頑張ったのですが・・子が今年大学進学で出ていくし
dialogue.English: Yes, I tried my best, but... our child is leaving for university this year, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: もう、笑顔の出ないこの家に居るのが
dialogue.English: being in this house where I can no longer smile...

dialogue.content: 苦痛で
dialogue.English: is painful.

dialogue.content: 朝の挨拶も
dialogue.English: Even morning greetings...

dialogue.content: 出来なくなって
dialogue.English: have become impossible.

dialogue.content: なるほど...お子さんがいらっしゃらないとさみしいですね
dialogue.English: I see... It will be lonely when your child is gone.

dialogue.content: 倦怠期なんでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I wonder if this is just a rough patch...?

dialogue.content: そのようにお感じになってしまいますよね...夫さんはいつ頃から怒るようになられたのですか？
dialogue.English: It's understandable that you would feel that way... When did your husband start getting angry like this?

dialogue.content: 失礼しました、来年大学です
dialogue.English: Oh, sorry, he starts university next year.

dialogue.content: 来年ですね。承知しました
dialogue.English: Next year. I understand.

dialogue.content: 結婚して二人で暮らしだして、主人の母親がしょっちゅう電話してきて、
dialogue.English: After we got married and started living together, his mother would call constantly,

dialogue.content: イライラしているのは分かったのですが
dialogue.English: and I could tell he was getting irritated,

dialogue.content: 結局何も言わず怒ってるって感じです
dialogue.English: but in the end, he wouldn't say anything and would just be angry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご結婚されたときから物静かな方だったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So he's been a quiet person ever since you got married.

dialogue.content: 新婚直ぐに何を考えてるのか分からないと言って私が泣いて朝までごねて
dialogue.English: Right after we got married, I cried and complained until morning, saying I didn't know what he was thinking.

dialogue.content: 主人も友達にも相談して
dialogue.English: My husband also talked to his friends about it.

dialogue.content: 主人の友達です
dialogue.English: His friends, I mean.

dialogue.content: 物静かなのは皆了解済みで
dialogue.English: Everyone already knew he was the quiet type,

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね...新婚当時から夫さんが物静かなことでお悩みだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see... So you've been concerned about your husband's quiet nature ever since you were newlyweds.

dialogue.content: 長いこととても我慢されて過ごされましたね
dialogue.English: You've been enduring this for a very long time.

dialogue.content: すこしお話まとめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きいさんは、夫さんとの関係でとても悩んでいらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: Kii, you're very troubled by your relationship with your husband.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは物静かな方で、口にだすことはあまりしません。顔にでてしまうタイプの方でいらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: Your husband is a quiet man who doesn't say much. He's the type whose feelings tend to show on his face.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: カラオケで歌わないと怒られてしまったり、
dialogue.English: He was yelled at for not singing at karaoke,

dialogue.content: ご両親ともうまくいかなかったり、
dialogue.English: he doesn't get along with his parents,

dialogue.content: お子さんの進路相談でも黙っていてお子さんもお困りのことがあったりです
dialogue.English: and he remains silent during discussions about your child's future, which has been difficult for your child as well.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはお酒をのまないと、きいさんともお話しないくらい物静かでいらっしゃって
dialogue.English: Your husband is so quiet that he won't even talk with you unless he's been drinking,

dialogue.content: そんな夫さんのことがよくわからないで新婚のときは泣いてお話されたこともありました
dialogue.English: and because you didn't understand him, there were times when you were newlyweds that you cried while trying to talk about it.

dialogue.content: いろいろときいさんが間になって夫さんのことをかばい、問題を解決されてきたこともありとても頑張っていらっしゃいました
dialogue.English: You have been trying very hard, stepping in to mediate, protect your husband, and resolve various problems.

dialogue.content: 離婚しようか考えるくらいお悩みでいらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: You're troubled to the point that you are now considering divorce.

dialogue.content: こんなかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: とても繊細なお悩みですこしでもお力になりたいと思います。一緒に考えていければと思います
dialogue.English: This is a very delicate issue, and I want to help in any way I can. I hope we can explore this together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yes, please.

dialogue.content: きいさんは板挟みになっているなか、自分のことより夫さんのことを考えておられますね
dialogue.English: Even while feeling caught in the middle, it seems you've been prioritizing your husband's needs over your own.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とてもお優しいかたですね。夫さんのこととても大事にされていることが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: You're a very kind person. It's clear that you care very deeply for your husband.

dialogue.content: 今はきいさんは夫さんの何が一番お困りですか？
dialogue.English: Right now, Kii, what is the biggest difficulty you're having with your husband?

dialogue.content: 何か二人で決めないといけない時に黙ってしまい
dialogue.English: When we have to decide something together, he just goes silent,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一緒にいろいろと相談して解決したいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to be able to discuss and resolve things together.

dialogue.content: 直ぐに返答しないといけない状況で何を考えてるのか分からない態度に、怒らせないよう、何度も我慢してきました。そこかな。
dialogue.English: In situations that require an immediate answer, his attitude makes it impossible to know what he's thinking. I've had to hold back so many times to avoid making him angry. I think that's it.

dialogue.content: とても気をつかっていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: You're being so very careful and considerate.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのことをたてていらっしゃってすばらしいですね
dialogue.English: It's admirable how you support your husband.

dialogue.content: 難しい人なんですよね
dialogue.English: He's a difficult person, you know.

dialogue.content: いろいろと決めるときはきいさんが決めていることが多いのですか？
dialogue.English: When it comes to making decisions, are you usually the one who decides?

dialogue.content: 難しいとわかっていて、とても夫さんのことを考えていらっしゃって偉いとおもいます
dialogue.English: Knowing how difficult he is, you still think so much about him. I think that's admirable.

dialogue.content: （すこしだけ時間延長させてください。おねがいいたします）
dialogue.English: (Please allow me to extend our time just a little. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: はい時間大丈夫です。やんわりと問いながら、夫の返事を三日ほど待ち。ようやく重い口を開いたら私が動く・・みたいな
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. I'll ask him gently, then wait about three days for a reply. When he finally speaks his mind, I'm the one who takes action... it's a pattern.

dialogue.content: なるほど..返事がくるまでも時間がかかることもあるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... so it can take a long time just to get a response from him.

dialogue.content: 大変ですね
dialogue.English: That must be difficult.

dialogue.content: 提案まではいきませんが、すこし私の考えをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's not quite a suggestion, but would it be alright if I shared a few of my thoughts with you?

dialogue.content: 分からない時は直ぐに分からんわーと笑って言って欲しいです
dialogue.English: When he doesn't know, I just wish he would laugh and say, "I don't know!" right away.

dialogue.content: 反応してほしいですよね...
dialogue.English: You just want some kind of reaction from him...

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Please go ahead.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もともと物静かな夫さんということでしたので、きっときいさんとバランスがとれているのかと感じました。
dialogue.English: You mentioned that your husband has always been a quiet person, so I was feeling that perhaps you and he balance each other.

dialogue.content: 今日、たくさんお話をしていただききいさんのお人柄や夫さんへの思いやりがとても伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: As you've shared so much today, I've really come to see your personality and the deep consideration you have for your husband.

dialogue.content: 子が熱出た時も黙るから、ほんと不安で一人で解決しました
dialogue.English: When our child had a fever, he was silent then too, so I was so anxious and had to handle it all by myself.

dialogue.content: とてもがんばりやさんで、パワフルな方なんだとおもいます
dialogue.English: I think you are a very hardworking and capable person.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはきっと物静かなことが普通なんだとおもいます。男性は表現を表にださないかたもいらっしゃるくらいなので、
dialogue.English: For your husband, being quiet is probably just his normal state. Some men don't show their emotions outwardly,

dialogue.content: 怒ったときだけでも顔にでて反応してくれているとかんじました
dialogue.English: so I get the sense that, at least when he's angry, he is giving you a reaction by showing it on his face.

dialogue.content: 物静かなことが個性なのかとかんじました
dialogue.English: I felt that perhaps his quiet nature is a part of his personality.

dialogue.content: そして、きいさんのことをとても信用しているのではないかとおもいます
dialogue.English: And I also think he must trust you a great deal, Kii.

dialogue.content: 夫さんが嫌でしたら何かいってくるとおもいます。それがないときは、嫌でないとうけとめきいさんのやりたいようにやるというのも手かな？とおもいました
dialogue.English: I believe if your husband truly disliked something, he would say so. When he doesn't, maybe you could take that as a sign that he's okay with it and do things your way? I thought that might be one approach.

dialogue.content: 夫さんに聞いたりすることはありますか？これでいい？とか？何か反応ありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever ask him? For example, "Is this okay?" Does he give you any reaction?

dialogue.content: きいさん、夫さんと見えない絆がつよいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Kii, perhaps you and your husband share a strong, invisible bond?

dialogue.content: 頭にきたことあって、別れをほのめかした事あります。やりたい事するから・・と。
dialogue.English: I've gotten so angry before that I've hinted at separation. I told him I was going to do what I wanted...

dialogue.content: その頭に
dialogue.English: Before I got that angry,

dialogue.content: 夫さんはどんな反応を？
dialogue.English: What was your husband's reaction?

dialogue.content: くるまでは、いつも聞いてました
dialogue.English: I always used to ask him before it came to that.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 夫さんはしっかりと反論したりするのですか？
dialogue.English: Does your husband ever properly argue back?

dialogue.content: 別れの言葉は、自分はこのままでいいと言い、やりたい事も文句あるなら言ってきて？と強引だったかも。夫の嫌いなお金のかかる事だったから。
dialogue.English: Regarding the talk of separation, I told him he was fine as he is, and that if he had a problem with what I wanted to do, he should say so. It might have been forceful of me, because it was about something that costs money, which he hates.

dialogue.content: 自分は何も言わないかわりに、プチンと切れたら終わりだからと初めにいわれてまして
dialogue.English: He told me at the beginning that while he wouldn't say much, if he ever snapped, it would be the end.

dialogue.content: 私も夫をたててきました
dialogue.English: So I've always been careful to be respectful toward him.

dialogue.content: なるほど...とても頑張ってらっしゃるのがわかります。夫さん、話すことで表現するのが苦手なのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see... I can tell you've been trying very hard. Perhaps your husband has difficulty expressing himself with words.

dialogue.content: いろんな問題が多い家庭だったから、
dialogue.English: Because we both came from families with a lot of problems,

dialogue.content: お互いの家が
dialogue.English: both of our families,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一緒に超えれると思っていたけど
dialogue.English: I thought we could overcome them together, but...

dialogue.content: 言葉が私も夫には出なくなりました
dialogue.English: now I've also found myself unable to talk to my husband.

dialogue.content: 言葉がでないほどたいへんなだったのですね
dialogue.English: It must have been so difficult that words failed you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしきいさん自信のお時間がつくれるようでしたら、夫のことを忘れられることができたらいいのかとおもいます。
dialogue.English: If you're able to make some time for yourself, I think it might be good to do something that allows you to take your mind off your husband for a while.

dialogue.content: そうなんです！
dialogue.English: That's it!

dialogue.content: たとえば、ひとりで遊びにいくとか。ご飯を食べに行くとか。
dialogue.English: For example, going out by yourself, or going out for a meal.

dialogue.content: だから、土日あわないように
dialogue.English: That's why on weekends I try to avoid being with him,

dialogue.content: 不定期な仕事で忙しくしたり、用事作ったり、
dialogue.English: by keeping myself busy with my irregular work schedule or making other plans.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: すみませんだらだらと・・
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for rambling on...

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: 他にももしできそうなことがありましたら、やってみて夫さんのこと忘れる時間作れるといいですね
dialogue.English: If there's anything else you think you could do, it would be good to try it and make some time to take your mind off your husband.

dialogue.content: 夫と離れて暮らしてみる
dialogue.English: Living apart from my husband for a while...

dialogue.content: を
考え中なのですが、
dialogue.English: is something I'm considering, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど...ひとつの手段として考えてみてもいいかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: I see... That might be an option worth considering.

dialogue.content: そうですよね？？
dialogue.English: You think so, right?

dialogue.content: いろんな手段があるとおもいますので、できることからやってみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I think there are many options, so please try starting with whatever feels doable for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 長く付き合って下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for spending so much time with me.

dialogue.content: 長いこと時間とってしまいましたが、本日お話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: We've gone on for quite some time, but how do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: ちょっとだけ勇気？よくない勇気かもしれないけど、前に進むために
dialogue.English: I feel a little bit of courage? Maybe it's not the 'good' kind of courage, but it's courage to move forward.

dialogue.content: 頑張ろうかなとおもいますた
dialogue.English: I think I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: 本日はお話を聴かせていただきありがとうございました。きいさん、頑張りすぎずご自分を大切にしてお過ごしくださいね。今後、いい方向に進むことをお祈りしています
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me today. Kii, please don't push yourself too hard and be sure to take care of yourself. I'll be hoping that things move in a better direction for you.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （とても長い時間対応していただきありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for staying for such a long session.)

dialogue.content: （大変勉強になりました。いたらぬことも多々ありましたがありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (I learned a great deal. There were many areas where I was lacking, but thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: いえいえ、お互い勉強！がんばりましょうね。
dialogue.English: Not at all, it's a learning experience for both of us! Let's both do our best.

dialogue.content: （本日のロールプレイしゅうりょうさせていただきますがよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Shall we conclude today's role-play session?)

dialogue.content: はい終了で、おねがいします。
dialogue.English: Yes, let's end it, please.

dialogue.content: （それでは、失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (Alright then, I'll sign off.)
